requirements.description: Monthly stock returns, prices, shares outstanding, and the cumulative share-adjustment factor (cfacshr) for constructing split-adjusted shares and the ISSUE/DT-ISSUE measures, 1926-2003
Point-in-time security name records (share code, exchange code, name period dates) for the universe filter and the 'at least 6 months in CRSP' listing-age rule; ncusip for the Compustat join
CRSP monthly market indexes providing EWRETD (equal-weighted return with dividends), used to impute missing monthly stock returns in holding-period return construction
Compustat annual fundamentals providing data60 (ceq, book value of common equity) for the post-1970 book-to-market variable, with format/consolidation/peer/population flags for standard filtering
CRSP-Compustat (CCM) link table to join Compustat book equity to CRSP permnos with link validity flags and date ranges
Monthly delisting records (delisting date, code, return) — used for diagnostics only; the paper does not use dlret, it imputes missing monthly returns with EWRETD per the Returns section (L116)
